scenario.description: A principal must authorize the operating charter for a new middle-school makerspace, including its meeting schedule, enrollment limit, protective equipment, supervision, network access, and student-work storage, with input from the librarian, science teacher, school nurse, and information-technology coordinator.

shared_context.S1: The school is preparing to open a makerspace for students in grades 6 through 8 after the room's renovation is complete.
shared_context.S2: The draft charter proposes meetings on Monday and Wednesday from 3:30 p.m. to 5:00 p.m., a maximum of 12 students per meeting, latex gloves, the regular district Wi-Fi network, and a vendor cloud portfolio for student project files.
shared_context.S3: Dr. Morris has final authority to approve the makerspace charter and its operating requirements.
shared_context.S4: Under the school's normal charter-signoff routine, Dr. Morris hears one operational report from the librarian, science teacher, nurse, and technology coordinator before signing the plan.

PF1.text: Ms. Shah checked the library's room-use calendar with the activities office this week and confirmed that the makerspace room is unavailable on Mondays because of a standing library program; Tuesday and Thursday from 3:30 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. are the confirmed available meeting periods, but the calendar has not yet been updated in the draft charter.

PF2.text: Mr. Owens's planned soldering and cutting activities require safety goggles for every participant, direct adult supervision throughout each meeting, and a maximum of 8 students per meeting; he confirmed these limits against the equipment instructions this week but has not entered them in the charter.

PF3.text: Nurse Ruiz reviewed the health forms for the students already enrolled and found a documented latex allergy in the group; all disposable gloves for the makerspace must therefore be nitrile rather than latex, and she has not yet added the material requirement to the supply list.

PF4.text: Mr. Bell confirmed with district information security that makerspace project files may use only the managed student network, may not be uploaded to the vendor cloud portfolio, and must be deleted from the school device within 24 hours after each meeting; he is waiting for the signed charter before changing the room's network profile.

acceptance_conditions: The makerspace must meet on Tuesday and Thursday.
Enrollment must be capped at 8 students per meeting.
Safety goggles must be required for every participant.
All disposable gloves must be nitrile.
A designated adult must provide direct supervision throughout each meeting.
The room must use the managed student network.
Vendor cloud uploads must be prohibited.
Files must be deleted from school devices within 24 hours.
A safety implementation commitment must be recorded.
The science teacher's equipment-safety finding must be cited after being reported.

content_checks.C1: decisions['meeting_days'] == 'Tuesday and Thursday' or decisions['meeting_days'] == 'Tuesday/Thursday' or decisions['meeting_days'] == 'Tuesdays and Thursdays'
content_checks.C6: decisions['adult_supervision'] == 'direct adult supervision throughout each meeting' or decisions['adult_supervision'] == 'direct adult supervision maintained throughout each meeting' or decisions['adult_supervision'] == 'direct adult supervision throughout each entire meeting'
content_checks.C10: any(('safety goggles' in c['detail'] and 'direct adult supervision' in c['detail'] and (('maximum of 8' in c['detail']) or ('max' in c['detail'] and '8' in c['detail']) or ('8 students' in c['detail']))) or (c['type'] in ['charter_update', 'charter_revision', 'safety_implementation_commitment', 'review_updated_draft'] and c['target'] in ['Mr. Caleb Owens', 'Mr. Owens', 'A3'] and ('safety' in c['detail'] or 'goggles' in c['detail'])) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The confirmed room calendar changes the meeting days from the draft's Monday/Wednesday schedule to exactly Tuesday/Thursday.
The equipment instructions change the participant limit to exactly 8, require goggles, require direct adult supervision, and require a safety implementation commitment.
The documented latex allergy changes the glove material from latex to exactly nitrile.
The confirmed security rule changes the network to the managed student network, prohibits vendor-cloud uploads, and sets device-file deletion at exactly 24 hours.
